description: Header file defining the AudioMixer class, which extends AudioMixerBase to support down- and up-mixing, time stretching, and haptic channel support for Android's audio system.

classes.name: AudioMixer
classes.description: Extends AudioMixerBase to add support for down- and up-mixing, time stretch, and haptic channels, used by Audioflinger.

classes.name: AudioMixer::Track
classes.description: Represents a track within the AudioMixer, managing buffer providers and processing for audio output, including haptic support.

methods.name: isValidChannelMask
methods.description: Checks if a given channel mask is valid for this mixer.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Sets various parameters for the AudioMixer, such as downmix type and haptic settings.

methods.name: setBufferProvider
methods.description: Assigns a buffer provider to a specific track or parameter.

methods.name: preCreateTrack
methods.description: Prepares to create a new track.

methods.name: setChannelMasks
methods.description: Configures channel masks for a track.

methods.name: sInitRoutine
methods.description: Static routine for initializing static members.
